tools.name: nx_status
tools.description: Report bridge, NX version, and active-part status.

tools.name: nx_create_part
tools.description: Create a part inside the configured workspace.

tools.name: nx_open_part
tools.description: Open a part from the configured workspace.

tools.name: nx_save_part
tools.description: Save the active work part.

tools.name: nx_close_part
tools.description: Close the active work part, optionally saving it first.

tools.name: nx_export_step
tools.description: Export the active work part as STEP inside the configured workspace.

tools.name: nx_list_sketches
tools.description: List sketches in the active work part.

tools.name: nx_list_bodies
tools.description: List bodies in the active work part.

tools.name: nx_list_features
tools.description: List features in the active work part.

tools.name: nx_list_edges
tools.description:
Inspect every edge of a body: index, curve type, endpoints, midpoint,
        length, bounding box, direction and adjacent face count. Read-only.

tools.name: nx_list_faces
tools.description:
Inspect every face of a body: index, tag, face type, centroid, area,
        normal (planar only) and adjacent edge count. Read-only.

tools.name: nx_create_sketch
tools.description: Create and activate a sketch on a principal datum plane.

tools.name: nx_sketch_line
tools.description: Add a line to an explicit sketch reference.

tools.name: nx_sketch_rectangle
tools.description: Add a rectangle to an explicit sketch reference.

tools.name: nx_sketch_circle
tools.description: Add a circle (center + diameter) to an explicit sketch reference.

tools.name: nx_sketch_arc
tools.description: Add an arc (center, radius, start/end degrees) to an explicit sketch reference.

tools.name: nx_finish_sketch
tools.description: Deactivate and finish an explicit sketch reference.

tools.name: nx_extrude
tools.description: Extrude a sketch into a new body, or subtract it from an existing target body.

tools.name: nx_hole
tools.description: Create a hole on a target body (circle sketch + boolean subtract).

tools.name: nx_counterbore_hole
tools.description:
Create a coaxial counterbore hole: a smaller deep through hole plus a
        larger shallow counterbore from the top face. Independent from nx_hole.

tools.name: nx_countersink_hole
tools.description:
Create a coaxial countersink (conical) hole: a smaller deep through
        cylinder plus a conical countersink from the top face. Independent of
        nx_hole / nx_counterbore_hole.

tools.name: nx_shell
tools.description:
Shell (hollow) a body: remove one face as an opening and keep a
        constant wall thickness. First version removes a single face; inward=True
        keeps the outer dimensions.

tools.name: nx_edge_blend
tools.description: Create an edge blend (fillet) on edges of a body; default all edges.

tools.name: nx_chamfer
tools.description: Create a symmetric chamfer on edges of a body; default all edges.

tools.name: nx_unite
tools.description:
Boolean-unite one or more tool bodies into the target body.

        The target body keeps its id; the tool bodies are consumed and
        disappear from ``nx_list_bodies`` after the boolean.

tools.name: nx_revolve
tools.description:
Revolve a closed sketch section around an in-sketch 2D axis.

        Creates a new solid only (no unite/subtract). ``axis_start`` and
        ``axis_end`` are sketch XY coordinates defining the revolution axis;
        ``angle`` is the sweep angle in degrees (0 < angle <= 360).

tools.name: nx_mirror
tools.description:
Mirror a body about a datum plane.

        ``plane`` selects the mirror datum plane (XY/XZ/YZ); ``offset`` shifts
        that plane along its normal by the given mm value (default 0). The
        mirrored body is created as an independent body and is NOT united with
        the source; use ``nx_unite`` if merging is required.

tools.name: nx_linear_pattern
tools.description:
Pattern a body linearly along X/Y/Z.

        ``count`` is the total number of instances including the original
        (count=4 yields 4 bodies); ``spacing`` is the per-instance delta in mm.
        The original body is kept and new instances are independent bodies
        (NOT united); use ``nx_unite`` if merging is required.

tools.name: nx_circular_pattern
tools.description:
Pattern a body circularly about an axis through ``center``.

        ``count`` is the total number of instances including the original
        (count=4 yields 4 bodies); ``angle`` is the total sweep in degrees
        (360.0 distributes evenly around a full circle). The original body is
        kept and new instances are independent bodies (NOT united); use
        ``nx_unite`` if merging is required.

tools.name: nx_undo
tools.description: Undo the last visible NX MCP operation.

tools.name: nx_fit_view
tools.description: Fit the active modeling view.

tools.name: nx_release
tools.description:
Clear the current task state and return NX to normal interaction.

        With the resident C# Loader backend, the Loader and named pipe remain
        alive for the entire NX session; nx_release does not unload the plugin
        or require Alt+F8 to start it again.

tools.name: nx_create_drawing_sheet
tools.description:
Create a drawing sheet and place a base view of the given model view.

        The part must already contain geometry for the base view to be meaningful.

tools.name: nx_create_projected_view
tools.description:
Project a view from an existing drafting view at sheet position (x, y).

        Leave parent_view_id empty to use the first drafting view on the sheet.

tools.name: nx_list_drawing_sheets
tools.description: List the drawing sheets in the active part.

tools.name: nx_list_drafting_views
tools.description: List the drafting views on the current drawing sheet.

tools.name: nx_list_dimensions
tools.description:
Read back every dimension in the part: measured size and tolerance.

        Returns one entry per dimension, formatted as
        "<journal_id>|<name>|size=<value>|tol=<upper>/<lower>|<tolerance_type>".
        Use this to verify dimensions you just created, or to READ an existing
        NX 2D drawing: sizes and tolerances are recovered from the model, so an
        agent can understand what a drawing specifies without opening the UI.

tools.name: nx_list_annotations
tools.description:
Read the non-dimension annotations of a drawing: notes, GD&T, roughness.

        Each entry is prefixed by kind:
          "NOTE|<journal_id>|<text>"            drafting / technical-requirement text
          "GDT|<journal_id>|<characteristic>|tol=<value>|datum=<d1>,<d2>,<d3>"
          "ROUGH|<journal_id>"                  surface finish symbol
        Use this together with nx_list_dimensions to fully understand an existing
        NX 2D process drawing.

tools.name: nx_create_radius_dimension
tools.description:
Create a RADIUS dimension on one edge (fillets, arcs, rounds).

        edge_index is the 0-based index from nx_list_edges on the given body.

tools.name: nx_delete_annotation
tools.description:
Delete a note / dimension / GDT / roughness annotation.

        Pass either its journal id or name (e.g. "LEN_120", "HANDLE R-5132"), or a
        "kind:index" selector: note:0, dim:1, gdt:0, rough:0 (0-based, in the order
        returned by nx_list_dimensions / nx_list_annotations).
        Useful for cleaning up test annotations that nx_undo cannot reach.

tools.name: nx_export_pdf
tools.description:
Export the current drawing display to a PDF file.

        Pass sheet_name to display that sheet first (the export follows the current
        display). Use nx_list_drawing_sheets to see available sheet names.

tools.name: nx_create_roughness
tools.description:
Create a surface finish (roughness) symbol on the current drawing sheet.

        value goes into the symbol's a1 slot - e.g. "1.6" for Ra 1.6, "3.2" for Ra 3.2.
        Position is in sheet coordinates (mm).

tools.name: nx_create_title_block
tools.description:
Place a title block on the current drawing sheet.

        Position is in sheet coordinates (mm); typically bottom-right, e.g.
        pos_x=340, pos_y=5 for an A3 landscape sheet.

tools.name: nx_set_attribute
tools.description:
Set a string attribute on the part.

        This is how a title block gets its CONTENT: title-block cells usually
        reference part attributes. Typical names: 名称 / 图号 / 材料 / 设计 /
        审核 / 比例 / 单位. Value may contain spaces.

tools.name: nx_list_attributes
tools.description: Read back all user attributes set on the part (title-block content).

tools.name: nx_measure_distance
tools.description:
Measure the minimum 3D distance between two edges of a body.

        This is a QUERY: no annotation is created. It returns the numeric distance
        (mm) plus the two closest points, so an agent can verify geometry instead of
        guessing. Indices are 0-based from nx_list_edges.

tools.name: nx_create_note
tools.description:
Add technical-requirement / process text to the current drawing sheet.

        Use "|" to start a new line, e.g. "技术要求|1. 未注倒角 C0.5|2. 调质 28-32HRC".
        Position is in sheet coordinates (mm).

tools.name: nx_create_diameter_dimension
tools.description:
Create a DIAMETER dimension on one edge (essential for shafts).

        A linear dimension between two edges cannot express a diameter; use this
        for cylindrical/circular features. edge_index is the 0-based index from
        nx_list_edges on the given body.

tools.name: nx_update_views
tools.description:
Force every drafting view on the current sheet to a fresh update.

        Clears the out-of-date ("clock") flag shown in the Part Navigator after a
        drawing or projected view is created or modified.

tools.name: nx_create_dimension
tools.description:
Create an associative linear dimension with a bilateral tolerance.

        Measures the distance between two model edges (selected by their 0-based
        index from nx_list_edges on the given body) inside the drafting view.
        Default tolerance is ±0.1 mm using the BilateralTwoLines style.

tools.name: nx_assembly_create
tools.description: Create a new independent NX12 assembly part inside the workspace.

tools.name: nx_assembly_add
tools.description:
Insert an existing .prt, optionally into a subassembly.

        Position is mm. Rotation is the NX12 nine-value component orientation
        matrix in API column order; identity is the default. Returned opaque
        component IDs are used by later tools; do not substitute display names.

tools.name: nx_assembly_list
tools.description: Read the actual component hierarchy, transforms, and part references.

tools.name: nx_assembly_transform
tools.description:
Set or increment component translation/orientation in owning assembly coordinates.

        Position is mm; rotation is a nine-value rigid NX orientation matrix.
        Transforms use the component definition in its direct parent prototype.
        Editing a nested definition affects every instance of that subassembly.
        List readback uses each occurrence's coordinate_part reference frame;
        do not reuse root occurrence coordinates as nested local inputs.

tools.name: nx_assembly_remove
tools.description: Remove an assembly occurrence; its source .prt file is retained.

tools.name: nx_assembly_replace
tools.description: Replace an occurrence with another workspace .prt using the NX12 API.

tools.name: nx_assembly_component_geometry
tools.description: Read occurrence face/edge selectors for assembly constraints.

tools.name: nx_assembly_constraint
nx_assembly_constraints
tools.description: Read persistent assembly constraints and their native solver states.

tools.name: nx_assembly_delete_constraint
tools.description:
Delete an explicit root-assembly constraint before repositioning its components.

        Obtain the current identifier from nx_assembly_constraints. Source
        prototype geometry and other constraints remain outside this operation.

tools.name: nx_assembly_solve
tools.description: Solve the active assembly constraint network and read resulting positions.

tools.name: nx_assembly_save
tools.description:
Save the root and workspace-owned subassemblies with checked load/save results.

        Files outside the configured workspace must never be written. The
        Loader validates every referenced prototype before performing saves.

tools.name: nx_assembly_interference
tools.description: Check actual component-pair interference; report native outcomes.

tools.name: nx_drafting_add_model_view
tools.description: Place an additional named model view, including an isometric view.

tools.name: nx_drafting_create_table
tools.description:
Create an editable NX tabular note, for title blocks or BOM tables.

        Dimensions and position are sheet mm. Text is explicit; the tool does
        not invent material, drawing numbers, or standard-compliance claims.

tools.name: nx_drafting_update_table
tools.description: Update explicit editable drawing-table cells by zero-based row/column.

tools.name: nx_drafting_list_tables
tools.description: Read actual drawing table cells, dimensions, and identifiers.

tools.name: nx_drafting_center_mark
tools.description: Create a center mark on a circular model edge in the selected view.

tools.name: nx_drafting_centerline
tools.description: Create a centerline from two explicit model-edge references.

tools.name: nx_drafting_detail_view
tools.description: Create a native detail view from an explicit sheet-coordinate region.

tools.name: nx_drafting_section_view
tools.description: Create a native section view from a stated cutting-line point/direction.

tools.name: nx_drafting_gdt
tools.description:
Create a native GD&T annotation from explicit NX-formatted tolerance text.

        Text and datum interpretation must be reviewed against the supplied
        drawing; creating a symbol does not infer a manufacturing requirement.

tools.name: nx_drafting_balloon
tools.description: Create a native parts-list balloon with optional explicit leader endpoint.

tools.name: nx_drafting_export_cad
tools.description: Export a sheet through the NX12 translator and verify the output file.

tools.name: nx_drawing_plan
tools.description:
Plan a part from an image and explicitly interpreted dimensions; does not perform OCR.

        No NX mutation occurs. Missing dimensions return needs_dimensions, and
        unexpected requirements require review. The image hash binds provenance.

tools.name: nx_model_check
tools.description: Read native geometry and check a matching image-plan part; no model mutation.

tools.name: nx_model_from_plan
tools.description:
Build a new independent NX12 part using existing MCP bridge commands.

        Supports explicit stepped shafts, plain flanges, prismatic L brackets,
        and uniform open-top boxes. Explicitly accepted tolerance-bounded polygonal gears are supported; manufacturing-grade gears are not. Every
        mutating command checks the active part; partial failures retain a trace.
